cowInitial:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one production animal illustration for a Japanese meat-cuts encyclopedia web app, displayed at small mobile sizes. Create a brand-new polished minimalist illustration of ONE adult beef cow (not a dairy pattern), standing in a perfectly left-facing side profile.
Style: contemporary editorial vector-like flat illustration, graceful anatomically plausible contour, medium-thin uniform dark warm-charcoal outline, broad uncluttered warm taupe and cream color areas, very restrained two-tone shading. Sophisticated, calm, exceptionally legible, not cartoonish, not a mascot. Clearly cow-shaped head, small horns, ears, long rectangular torso, four distinct legs with hooves, tail on the right. Do not draw eyes as large circles.
Canvas: landscape 3:2, preferably 1536 x 1024, genuinely transparent background. Show the complete animal from horns to hooves to tail with 8 percent clear padding. Cow spans roughly x=8 to 92 percent and y=16 to 88 percent. Back mostly horizontal. Neutral standing pose.
Critical: this is a neutral silhouette onto which the website will add its own red position marker. NO meat-cut divisions, NO anatomical partition lines on the torso, NO red areas, NO labels, NO text, NO numbers, NO chart elements, NO background, NO ground line, NO drop shadow, NO gradients, NO grain, NO photo texture, NO 3D rendering. A single animal only.
cowRefinement:
Edit the referenced cow illustration into a MUCH SIMPLER, lighter, crisp flat editorial pictogram for a mobile meat-cut encyclopedia. Keep the left-facing standing cow, whole body and legs, landscape 3:2 format.
Replace the entire rendering style: a clean Scandinavian field-guide graphic built from large smooth solid-color shapes. Pale warm stone body (#DED9CF), cream muzzle and horns, a few subtle darker stone shapes only to separate the far legs. A single thin smooth charcoal contour (#4C514D). Small discreet eye. Nearly uniform body color so a red location marker will be easy to see.
Remove EVERY hair stroke, fur detail, muscle contour, streak, texture, painterly brushstroke, brown tonal rendering, gradient, shadow, glow and vignette. Keep the body very plain with no internal lines except limb attachment and ear. Do not make it a sticker or use a white sticker border. NO meat-cut lines.
Strong requirements: truly transparent empty background, no shadow anywhere, opaque animal. Generous clean empty margins on all four sides, full animal visible, suitable at 240px wide. Modern and refined flat vector-like illustration, not realistic and not ornate. NO text or labels.
